newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot gas softens again on weather, outages.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot gas softens again on weather, outages.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices continued to soften Thursday amid warm western Canadian weather and scheduled maintenance outages, traders said.

Spot gas at Alberta's AECO storage hub was talked about three cents lower at C$1.62-1.64 per gigajoule (GJ), as today's temperatures in Calgary were forecast to reach a high of about 25 degrees Celsius.
"We're in between a bunch of plant outages right now," one Calgary-based source said, adding flow restrictions at Empress due to plant outages were keeping downward pressure on prices.
